title: Trump’s Iran Sanctions Have a China Problem
content: US President Donald Trump is trying to pressure the Iranian regime by isolating it from the dollar-based financial system. title: When AI Stops Asking Permission
content: The most useful lesson from this summer’s breach of Hugging Face by a swarm of OpenAI agents is about architecture, not intentions. AI agents need protective layers—limited access, separate authorization for sensitive actions, records nobody can quietly edit, and outside testing before deployment—not a lecture about good behavior.

content: Radical right-wing parties have advanced across Western countries by successfully tying immigration to voters’ diffuse fears about their economic well-being, personal security, and cultural identity.
